pcv3.empty.title: Choose a file
pcv3.empty.body: Choose one file to decrypt, recover, or open explicitly as PCV3 D1.
pcv3.routing.failed: The selected file could not be classified safely. No operation was started.
pcv3.format.label: Format:
pcv3.action.label: PCV3 operation
pcv3.factor.label: Credential policy
pcv3.order.label: Keyfile order
pcv3.intent.policy_required: Choose the credential policy used for this operation.
pcv3.intent.factor_mismatch: The selected factors do not match the credential policy.
pcv3.consent.title: Recover unverified data?
pcv3.consent.body: This operation can save bytes that are not authenticated. They may be incomplete, corrupted, or unsafe to open. Choose the exact physical source to use.
pcv3.consent.acknowledgement: I understand that this output is unverified.
pcv3.resource.busy.title: Another secure operation is running
pcv3.resource.busy.body: Wait for it to finish. This operation did not start, and no output was created.
pcv3.resource.insufficient.title: Required resources are unavailable
pcv3.resource.insufficient.body: This device cannot safely run the fixed security profile right now. Security settings were not reduced, and no output was created.
pcv3.resource.unknown.title: Device resources could not be verified
pcv3.resource.unknown.body: The operation stopped before key derivation. No output was created.
pcv3.outcome.archive_pending.title: Authenticated archive ready to extract
pcv3.outcome.archive_pending.body: The archive payload is fully authenticated. Choose a new extraction folder. The encrypted source is kept.
pcv3.outcome.success.title: Decryption complete
pcv3.outcome.degraded.title: Authenticated output recovered with damage
pcv3.outcome.degraded.body: The output is authenticated, but recovery redundancy is damaged. Keep the original volume.
pcv3.outcome.force_partial.title: Partial recovery artifact created
pcv3.outcome.force_partial.body: Some ranges are verified and some are missing. This .pcv3-recovery file is not a complete plaintext file.
pcv3.outcome.force_unverified.title: Unverified recovery artifact created
pcv3.outcome.force_unverified.body: Some recovered bytes are not authenticated and may be corrupted or unsafe. Do not open or extract this artifact as trusted content.
pcv3.outcome.credentials_or_damage.title: Credentials or recovery data could not be verified
pcv3.outcome.credentials_or_damage.body: Check the selected credential policy, keyfiles, and keyfile order. No output was published.
pcv3.outcome.authentication_failed.title: Authentication failed
pcv3.outcome.authentication_failed.body: No output was published. Recovery was not started automatically.
pcv3.outcome.ambiguous.title: Conflicting authenticated recovery data
pcv3.outcome.ambiguous.body: No output was published. Keep the original volume and do not choose a candidate in the frontend.
pcv3.outcome.unsupported.title: Unsupported PCV3 format
pcv3.outcome.unsupported.body: No output was created, and the file was not tried as a legacy volume.
pcv3.outcome.invalid_structure.title: Invalid or damaged PCV3 structure
pcv3.outcome.invalid_structure.body: The operation stopped before credential processing and output creation.
pcv3.outcome.credential_mismatch.title: Credential policy does not match
pcv3.outcome.credential_mismatch.body: Check password/keyfile mode, keyfile count, and keyfile order. No key derivation or output started.
pcv3.outcome.cancelled.title: Operation cancelled
pcv3.outcome.cancelled.body: No completed output was reported. Source files were kept.
pcv3.outcome.generic.title: Operation failed
pcv3.outcome.generic.body: The operation failed safely. No output was published. Keep the source and review the reported state.
pcv3.publication.not_requested.title: No output was requested
pcv3.publication.not_requested.body: The authenticated archive was closed without extraction. The encrypted source was kept.
pcv3.publication.not_published.title: No output was published
pcv3.publication.uncertain.title: Output durability not confirmed
pcv3.publication.uncertain.body: The destination may contain the output, but filesystem durability could not be confirmed. Keep every source and the destination. Do not retry, replace, delete, or clean up this operation.
pcv3.publication.indeterminate.title: Output state is unknown
pcv3.publication.indeterminate.body: The application cannot determine whether publication committed. Keep every source and the destination exactly as they are. Do not retry or clean up this operation.
pcv3.warning.degraded: The output is authenticated, but recovery redundancy is damaged. Keep the original volume.
pcv3.warning.force_partial: Some ranges are verified and some are missing. This .pcv3-recovery file is not a complete plaintext file.
pcv3.warning.force_unverified: Some recovered bytes are not authenticated and may be corrupted or unsafe. Do not open or extract this artifact as trusted content.
pcv3.warning.durability_uncertain: Output durability was not confirmed. Keep every source and the destination.
pcv3.warning.publication_indeterminate: Output publication state is unknown. Keep every source and the destination exactly as they are.
pcv3.warning.cleanup_incomplete: The application could not prove that all operation-owned temporary plaintext was removed. Keep the encrypted source and do not delete files based on this result.
pcv3.warning.callback_failure: A user-interface callback failed. No additional action was authorized.
